Page 1 of 9 
Q. 
Please identify the members of the Rate Design Panel. 
1 
A. 
The Rate Design Panel consists of Kellie I. Smith, Dawn M. Herrity, 
2 
Melissa M. Barnes, and Howard S. Gorman.  This is the same Panel that 
3 
submitted direct testimony as part of KEDNY’s April 28, 2023 filing.  The 
4 
terms defined in the Panel’s direct testimony have the same meaning here. 
5 
 
6 
Q. 
What is the purpose of the Panel’s corrections and updates testimony? 
7 
A. 
The Panel provides corrections and updates to certain items in its direct 
8 
testimony and certain exhibits.  The Panel is updating its ECOSS, revenue 
9 
allocation, rate design, and associated rates (including the MFC) based on 
10 
corrections and updates to the Company’s revenue requirement and other 
11 
changes identified since the April 28, 2023 filing.  The Panel also provides 
12 
revised bill impacts based on the corrected and updated information.  
13 
Further, the Panel is updating its revenue at current rates and commodity 
14 
forecasts presented in its direct testimony.  
15 
 
16 
Q. 
Does the Panel sponsor any exhibits to its corrections and updates 
17 
testimony? 
18 
A. 
Yes.  The Panel prepared the following exhibits: 
19 
• Exhibit __ (RDP-2CU) provides the Company’s revenue forecast at 
20 
current delivery rates, by service class, for the Rate Year and Data 
21

Corrections and Updates Testimony of the Rate Design Panel (KEDNY) 
Page 2 of 9 
Years, and sets forth the proposed changes to miscellaneous and 
1 
other revenues; 
2 
• Exhibit __ (RDP-3CU) is the updated ECOSS for the Rate Year; 
3 
• Exhibit __ (RDP-4CU) presents the Company’s proposed revenue 
4 
allocation, rate design, and customer bill impacts for the Rate Year; 
5 
• Exhibit __ (RDP-6CU) sets forth the proposed MFC; 
6 
• Exhibit __ (RDP-7CU) sets forth the revenue per class targets for

• Exhibit __ (RDP-12CU) presents the updated ECOSS with Mains

12 
• Exhibit __ (RDP-14CU) sets forth the Electric Generator revenue

• Exhibit __ (RDP-15CU) contains workpapers supporting various

Q. 
Please describe Exhibit __ (RDP-2CU). 
18 
A. 
Exhibit __ (RDP-2CU) provides the Company’s revenue at current rates for 
19 
the Rate Year and Data Years.  The Company is updating revenue at current 
20 
rates, including the MFC and commodity revenue, to reflect the updated 
21 


--- Page 4 ---
Corrections and Updates Testimony of the Rate Design Panel (KEDNY) 
Page 3 of 9 
sales forecast as explained in the Corrections and Updates Testimony of the 
1 
Gas Load Forecasting Panel, as well as the updates to the forecast of 
2 
commodity costs as explained in the Corrections and Updates Testimony of 
3 
the Gas Supply Panel.  The Company is also updating several miscellaneous 
4 
revenue items to reflect updated inflation factors as described in the 
5 
Corrections and Updates Testimony of the Revenue Requirements Panel.     
6 
 
7 
 
The Panel is also correcting several items from the revenue forecast 
8 
submitted in the original filing.  First, the Panel is updating the pricing 
9 
model to address the following corrections: (i) block one usage for service 
10 
classifications 17-4A and 17-4 CNG, which inadvertently used three therms 
11 
rather than the correct ten therms per customer; (ii) the MTA tax rate for 
12 
service classification 22 Non-Firm Demand Response Tier 2 (rate code 
13 
134), which inadvertently used 0.0480 percent rather than the correct rate 
14 
of 0.1050 percent; (iii) the Gross Revenue Tax (“GRT”) rate for service 
15 
classifications 21 Baseload Distributed Generation Sales and 22 Non-Firm 
16 
Demand Response Tier 1 (rate codes 42 and 133, respectively), which 
17 
inadvertently used 4.548 percent rather than the correct rate of 2.407 
18 
percent; and (iv) the GRT rate for service classification 22 Non-Firm 
19 
Demand Response Tier 1 (rate code 435), which inadvertently used 2.407 
20 
percent rather than the correct rate of 4.548 percent.  
21 


--- Page 5 ---
Corrections and Updates Testimony of the Rate Design Panel (KEDNY) 
Page 4 of 9 
 
The corrections of block one usage for the service classifications noted 
1 
above were carried through to the Company’s rate design. 
2 
   
3 
 
Second, the Company is updating its revenue forecast for Newtown Creek 
4 
to reflect the vendor commission paid on the sale of environmental 
5 
attributes.    
6 
 
7 
 
Third, the Company is updating its Electric Generator revenue forecast to 
8 
include the annual bill requirement for one customer as opposed to using 
9 
the customer’s actual price out of revenues.  The change increases the 
10 
Electric Generator revenue forecast by $116,876.    
11 
 
12 
Lastly, the Company is updating the Late Payment Charge calculation to 
13 
include Electric Generator revenues as it was inadvertently excluded in the 
14 
original calculation as filed.   
15 
 
16 
Q. 
Please describe Exhibit __ (RDP-3CU). 
17 
A. 
Exhibit __ (RDP-3CU) provides the Company’s ECOSS, which has been 
18 
updated to reflect the updated sales and revenue forecasts and revenue 
19 
requirement.  Further, the Company changed the allocation of Demand Side 
20 
Management and Energy Efficiency costs from Gas Deliveries Firm to Gas 
21 


--- Page 6 ---
Corrections and Updates Testimony of the Rate Design Panel (KEDNY) 
Page 5 of 9 
Deliveries Total because Non-Firm Demand Response customers are 
1 
eligible to participate in these programs.  No other changes were made to 
2 
the ECOSS. 
3 
 
4 
Q. 
Please describe Exhibit __ (RDP-4CU). 
5 
A. 
Exhibit __ (RDP-4CU) provides the Company’s revenue allocation 
6 
schedules.  The Panel updated these schedules to reflect the updated results 
7 
of the ECOSS, including the sales and revenue forecasts and revenue 
8 
requirements.  To update the revenue allocation, the percentage increase in 
9 
revenue assigned to each service classification in the Company’s April 28, 
10 
2023 filing was increased by three percentage points (e.g., classes in the 
11 
Over category were changed from 27 percent increases to 30 percent 
12 
increases), with one exception for SC 1B, which fell into the expanded 
13 
Within tolerance band.  The tolerance band for the Within category was 
14 
widened to include service classifications between 0.60 times the average 
15 
rate of return to 1.4 times the average rate of return in this Corrections and 
16 
Updates filing, and the percentage increase in revenue for Within classes 
17 
was increased by 2.82 percentage points.  The revenue allocation is 
18 
presented on Exhibit __ (RDP-4CU), Schedule 1. 
19 
  
20 


--- Page 7 ---
Corrections and Updates Testimony of the Rate Design Panel (KEDNY) 
Page 6 of 9 
 
The Company’s updated rate design is presented on Exhibit __ (RDP-4CU), 
1 
Schedule 3.  The proposed Customer Charges for each service class remain 
2 
the same as in the April 28, 2023 filing, except for SC21, where the 
3 
Customer Charge was increased by 15 percent from current rates, rather 
4 
than the 10 percent increase proposed in the initial filing, and the Demand 
5 
Charge was increased by 27.5 percent, rather than the 25 percent increase 
6 
proposed in the initial filing.  The changes in slope (tail block compared to 
7 
mid-block) for each rate class are the same as originally proposed.  The 
8 
changes in SC1B rates required the Incremental Low-Income discounts to 
9 
be updated, which is presented on Exhibit___(RDP-4CU), Schedule 7.  The 
10 
proposed rates produce the revenue target for each class that is developed 
11 
on Exhibit __ (RDP-4CU), Schedule 1.  The proposed rates for the Non-
12 
Firm Demand Tier 1 are 54 percent lower than the SC2 and SC3 tail block 
13 
rates; the proposed rates for Tier 2 are 63 percent lower than the SC2 and 
14 
SC3 tail block rates.  These discounts are slightly less than the 55 percent 
15 
and 65 percent the Company had targeted but the Company intends to meet 
16 
the original targets when the final revenue allocation and rate design are 
17 
developed.  A summary of the proposed rates is presented on Exhibit __ 
18 
(RDP-4CU), Schedule 8.  
19 
 
20

Corrections and Updates Testimony of the Rate Design Panel (KEDNY)

The bill impacts resulting from the updated and corrected rates are presented 
1 
on Exhibit __ (RDP-4CU), Schedule 4.  These bill impacts reflect a 
2 
reduction in supply rates from the Company’s original filing due to the 
3 
updated commodity forecast.  The decrease in forecast supply rates will help 
4 
to mitigate overall bill impacts for customers. 
5
